findings.title: Stale round-1 mailbox receipt tested only at S2
findings.detail:
The Plan's Risks say the stale-mailbox case is covered in S1 with a second clone using the existing mailbox setup. Only decide.test covers it, and the first of those tests passes even without the round check (its reason is 'not at ready#1'). The same-cursor test does exercise the round check.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Add the S1 second-clone case to human.test's mailbox section.

findings.title: AC7 uses a different fixture than the criterion states
findings.detail:
The AC says 'a finished reproduce round … --workflow quick --at sync', with a refusal naming quick's steps. The test uses triage→story with --at build and story's steps, because the harness's quick has no sync step. The mechanism is the same.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Acceptable, or add a sync step to the harness quick.

findings.title: AC8 'nothing changes' compares receipts only
findings.detail:
The test does not check that state.json is unchanged after the round_unfinished refusal.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Assert that the state file is unchanged too.

findings.title: Writes after the commit point are not repaired if act stops
findings.detail:
After the new round's state.json is written, act still writes the old round's ended state, traces the rejected later receipts, patches spec workflow:, and commits. If act stops after the commit point, the old state is stale (the code accepts this), the spec frontmatter still names the old workflow, and the rejections are never traced. No later tick repairs this, because currentRound now resolves to round 2. Also, a failed patchStoryFile is reported only in the detail of an ok:true result (line 361). The docstring at line 338 and the RoundStartAction comment (core actions.ts:357) describe the old write order.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Make the frontmatter patch and the trace idempotent on the next tick, or document the drift as accepted. Fix the comments.

findings.title: Rerun command always adds --at
findings.detail:
The workflow_changed park command adds --at <to> even when the person did not pass --at.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Add --at only when the receipt's to differs from the workflow's first step.

findings.title: do_instead names --force, which slice 08 adds
findings.detail:
The round_unfinished hint is not runnable until slice 08 lands. The spec does this on purpose (AC8). Decide also already accepts forced:true receipts (story.ts:426), which only 08 will write.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Make sure 08 lands with this slice's story.

findings.title: slice-workflow e2e transcript red on this branch (pre-existing, not this slice)
findings.detail:
bun run test:e2e test/e2e/slice-workflow.test.ts gives 21/1. The one extra line is '+ A.notifier.notify round_done:gh-7:runs/_story/rounds/01-mini'. The round_done item and its notify come from slice 05 (items.ts:578 on the base). This diff changes neither that path nor the transcript. The slice lists bun run test:e2e as a check, so CI will be red on the story PR until someone fixes the notify timing or regenerates the transcript.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: A person decides whether this is a bug (the round-done notify fires before a sync has seen the PR that was just opened) or an intended change to regenerate. Track it outside this slice.
